components.name: Text link
components.description: Blue inline link for academic sources and contact actions.
components.css: .ds-link { color: var(--blue, #1769aa); font: 14px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; text-underline-offset: 3px; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1769aa); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Utility button
components.description: Small rectangular control for a direct utility action.
components.css: .ds-button { padding: 5px 10px; border: 1px solid var(--line, #ddd); border-radius: 2px; color: var(--blue, #1769aa); background: #fff; font: 14px/1.55 system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-button:hover { border-color: var(--blue, #1769aa); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1769aa); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button:active { color: #222; }

narrative.overview: The approved reference is xuyanye.com. The website uses a plain white surface, familiar system typography, restrained blue links, and thin separators so academic content carries the page. The identity sidebar and dense, readable content rows form the recurring composition.
keyCharacteristics: Compact text and simple academic hierarchy.
Linked publications, dated news, and accessible disclosures.
Bilingual routes with a consistent shared shell.

rules.name: The White Surface Rule
rules.body: Keep the main public page surface white and fixed to light mode.

dos: Do keep public page backgrounds white and use system sans-serif text.
Do preserve clear keyboard focus, ordinary links, authorship marks, and language controls.
Do use thin separators and flat content rows.
Do keep contacts visible when the sidebar stacks on mobile.
Use underlined content links and plain bold publication titles with per-paper author notes.
Use the approved pale internship callout, rounded News window, and compact Star badges.
donts: Don't add glass panels, decorative meshes, background grids, or large shadows.
Don't turn ordinary tags or resource links into pills; approved compact Star and paper badges remain.
Don't add section eyebrows; keep the user-requested ACMer animation confined to the identity mark and honor reduced motion.
Don't hide the entire sidebar on mobile or add a second mobile navigation.
